sitemap.purpose: Inventory of real University of Warwick campus learning resource booking portals, permission models, and extractable data sources for A1 prototype realism.

central_timetabling_wrb.name: Central Timetabling — Web Room Booking (Scientia WRB)

permissions_and_rules.who_can_book: Current Warwick students and staff (separate Scientia logon; teaching work areas are staff-only).
permissions_and_rules.approval: Verified live as PGT student u5838393: 152 CENTRAL rooms on Main Site appear, ALL flagged Request? = P (pending Central Timetabling approval, 1 working day notice); local departmental rooms and teaching work areas are hidden from students.
permissions_and_rules.capacity_rule: Shows rooms up to 1.5x entered group size to prevent small groups booking oversized rooms.
permissions_and_rules.booking_slots: Hourly slots 09:00-22:00 (duration 1h-13h), single date or recurring multi-day/week; filters by Group Size (1-500), Zone (Main/Gibbet Hill/Westwood), and 13 AV/facility suitabilities.
permissions_and_rules.privacy_split: Two text fields: 'Meaningful Reference' (public on timetable reports) vs 'Other information' (private to booking staff).
permissions_and_rules.sanctions: Breach of terms (e.g. food/drink in CTTR) may revoke booking rights or escalate under Regulation 23.

raw_snapshots: database/raw/wrb/student_rooms.json (152 live student-bookable WRB rooms with size, zone, Request?=P)
database/raw/warwick_rooms/central_av_tags.json (215 rooms with exact AV facility tags from 24 tags)
database/raw/warwick_rooms/meeting_av_tags.json (39 meeting rooms with exact AV facility tags from 12 tags)
database/raw/mazemap/buildings.json (205 named Warwick buildings with WGS84 GPS coordinates & floor levels)

library_spaces_and_roombooking.name: Warwick Library Spaces, Study Rooms & Specialist Rooms

permissions_and_rules.verified_student_view: Logged in as PGT student u5838393 on RoomBooking.dll: only 2 room types visible ('Group Study Room', 'Online Meeting Room'); 'Accessible Study Room' is completely hidden unless registered with Disability Services. Actions limited to Create Booking + View/Cancel Existing Booking.
permissions_and_rules.accessible_study_rooms: Restricted to students registered with Disability Services; max 3 hours/day (1h + 2h slots); book up to 4 weeks ahead; mandatory ID card tap at door or auto-cancelled as no-show.
permissions_and_rules.pg_hub_rooms: Postgraduate student groups only (no staff, no solo calls); max 3 hours guideline; Rooms 1-5 moved to first-come-first-served, Room 7 remains bookable (Disability Services).
permissions_and_rules.creative_community_place: Restricted (HTTP 403 for PGT student u5838393 — staff/authorised requestors only).
permissions_and_rules.research_exchange_and_tls: SSO-gated SiteBuilder request forms accessible to PG students and staff (requires approval).

raw_snapshots: database/raw/library/bookable_rooms.json (7 Accessible Study Rooms + 6 PG Hub rooms + observed Rootes Group Study PIN flow)

idg_work_areas.name: IDG Open Access PC Work Areas (Computer Labs)

permissions_and_rules.student_access: Drop-in card access for students; live PC availability refreshed every 60s.
permissions_and_rules.booking_access: Only staff can book work areas for teaching sessions via Scientia WRB.

raw_snapshots: database/raw/workareas/metadata.json (54 deduplicated room metadata records with bookable/linux/AV flags)

permissions_and_rules.who_can_borrow: Current Warwick students only (no visitors, external members, or alumni).
permissions_and_rules.loan_period: Up to 7 days (both Library Floor 1 Lobby lockers via ID card swipe and ServiceNow self-service loan).
permissions_and_rules.overdue_policy: Reminder emails -> phone -> department escalation -> temporary account restriction or loss of eligibility.

myadvantage_academic_support.name: myAdvantage — 1-on-1 Support Appointments & Academic Skills Workshops

permissions_and_rules.who_can_book: SSO-authenticated Warwick students and staff (separate Employer portal for external users).
permissions_and_rules.attendance_tracking: Tracks booked, cancelled (with structured reasonType), and absent/no-show states.

raw_snapshots: database/raw/myadvantage/events.json (112 upcoming student events & academic/career workshops)

workareas_live.notes: Live JSON snapshot of Open Access PC Labs across Warwick campuses (refreshed every 60s on IDG work-areas page). Supports JSONP via ?callback=.

gotchas: Only returns currently active/monitored workareas (12 labs as of 2026-11-26); join with SiteBuilder entries.json for bookable/linux/avEquipment flags and opening hours.

auth.notes: central_rooms and workareas_metadata are public; meeting_rooms and local_rooms require Warwick SSO (websignon.warwick.ac.uk).

central_rooms.notes: JS data file defining var roomData with 25 buildings and 214 centrally timetabled teaching rooms.

meeting_rooms.notes: JS data file with 7 buildings and 48 centrally managed meeting & consultation rooms.

local_rooms.notes: JS data file with 34 academic/support departments and 194 locally timetabled departmental rooms.

response_fields: items[].metadata (JSON string: bookable, avEquipment, linux, nonITS, mapLink)
workareas_metadata.notes: Contains historical duplicate entries per room title; deduplicate by keeping highest lastUpdated per title.

room_av_tags.auth: mixed (public for roominformation; sso for meetingrooms)
room_av_tags.notes: Passing includeTags=true returns all page tags + Capacity in one request (230 central rooms, 35 active AV kit tags verified against /services/idg/services-support/av/AVkitList.js, plus 360 panorama URL convention .../roominformation/<slug>/<slug>.jpg). Meeting rooms remain SSO-protected (39 rooms).

official_departments.notes: Embedded SiteBuilder form JSON contains Warwick's official 52-department faculty-prefixed directory.

gotchas: room-data.js files use JS object literal syntax (single quotes, unquoted keys, leading zeros like 03 in meetingrooms/room-data.js, /* */ comments in local/room-data.js) rather than strict JSON; evaluate in JS or parse leniently.
SSO-protected SiteBuilder paths return HTTP 200 HTML titled 'Sign in' when unauthenticated; fetch via signed-in Chrome session (omni).

auth.notes: Public live occupancy board; optional SSO header.

response_fields: occupancy_status (Full or nearly full | Some spaces available | Lots of spaces available | Closed)
occupancy_html.notes: Server-rendered HTML (no JSON API on /api/spaces). Parse structured space cards from main container.

gotchas: No public JSON endpoint; HTML structure is clean and deterministic.

appointment_topics.notes: Server-rendered HTML list of 12 student 1-on-1 support appointment topics (Careers, MASP, Course Change, Disability Careers, Visa).

event_search.notes: JSON API covering Academic Skills & Library workshops (e.g. Library Skills and Literature Planning). Requires active SSO session.

gotchas: Expired session redirects to /students/login or returns HTML 'myAdvantage Login'; verify content-type before parsing JSON.

campus_collection.notes: Returns Warwick campus geometries and campusIds (2188 = Central Campus, plus Innovation Campus Warwick).

response_fields: buildings[].simpleGeom (EPSG:3857 polygon -> convert to WGS84 lat/lon)
buildings.notes: Returns 205 named Warwick campus buildings (54 blank/unnamed footprints filtered out) with floor lists and map geometries (no auth required).

gotchas: search.mazemap.com/search/equery returns HTTP 403 to bare Python urllib requests without browser headers/referer.

auth.notes: Legacy Delphi IntraWeb DLL (RoomBooking.dll) with separate username/password form (no SAML SSO). Used for Library group study rooms and Disability-registered Accessible Study Rooms.

gotchas: Stateful IntraWeb session URLs (/RoomBooking.dll/EXEC/...) — no REST API.

auth.notes: Scientia Enterprise 4.0.1.24 ASP.NET WebForms portal for Central Timetabling Web Room Bookings (CTTR) and staff Work Area teaching bookings.

gotchas: ASP.NET __VIEWSTATE WebForms portal; no public JSON API. Room catalogue itself is exposed publicly via warwick.ac.uk room-data.js files.
